items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I went to Flint, Michigan, with Jimmy Lucky. He had a little six-piece band and Bernie Peacock was in the band and we did Grand Rapids and we did Flint.

ctx.x: So did this become a regular job?
We stayed there all that summer and then I went to Flint, Michigan, with Jimmy Lucky. He had a little six-piece band and Bernie Peacock was in the band and we did Grand Rapids and we did Flint.
